name: Theme showcase (with code preview)
description: Two-column section: copy + 'layouts/partials/blocks' explainer rows on the left, faux-IDE code preview on the right. The three rows and the code body are fields so editors can change them without touching code.

field_schema.label: Lead paragraph
field_schema.help: May include inline <code> for accent words.

field_schema.label: Explainer rows
field_schema.help: Three rows recommended (Layouts / Partials / Blocks). Color: teal | violet | magenta | coral | lime | amber.

field_schema.label: Code header — file path
field_schema.help: Shown at the top of the IDE-style block.

field_schema.label: Code language
field_schema.help: Auto syntax highlighter applies on render.

field_schema.label: Code body
field_schema.help: Use the WYSIWYG code-block button. Highlighter runs on render — no manual span markup.

test_data.lead: A Squilla theme is a self-contained package: layouts, partials, content blocks, assets, Tengo scripts that seed content on activation. Activating a theme runs its theme.tengo script — registering node types, taxonomies, and seeding pages — with zero server restart.

rows.value: Atomic content units. Self-contained, schema-defined, render with their own field data only.

test_data.callout: Activate a theme. The CMS reorganizes itself around it. No restart.
test_data.heading:
Themes are
sovereign too.
test_data.code_body:
core    := import("core/cms")
nodes   := import("core/nodes")
events  := import("core/events")

// register the recipe node type
nodes.register_type({
  slug: "recipe",
  fields: [
    {name: "hero_image",   type: "media"},
    {name: "prep_minutes", type: "int"},
    {name: "servings",     type: "int"},
    {name: "ingredients",  type: "repeater"},
    {name: "instructions", type: "richtext"},
  ]
})

// seed a starter recipe
core.node_create({
  type:  "recipe",
  title: "Caramelized scallops",
  fields: { prep_minutes: 18, servings: 2 }
})

events.emit("theme.seeded", { theme: "hello-vietnam" })
